title: Be prepared to glue
text: Be prepared to glue. The product arrived in the mail quickly. I wanted something fancier than just the plastic "O" rings.  As others have said, when I opened the package the bulbs had fallen off of four of the hooks. I am sure the company could make more money if they invested in a better glue or quality control.  Other than that they seem to hang on the rod fine but I have not tested to see what happens after going in and out of the shower to see if the hooks or curtains fall down.
